title: The Field That Was Quietly Zero: Reading JSON Without Letting a Missing Value, a String or a Big Number Pass for a Good One
fallback: This lesson is about how Qt reads JSON, so it needs Qt. Lesson 00-10 and lesson 03-15 ask the same questions of text typed by a person and of numbers read back, with nothing but the standard library. Without Qt, do those and come back when Qt is installed.

artifact.note: JSON fields read with an error that says missing, wrong type, not whole or out of range, and an identifier read without losing its low digits
